name: Scatter plot
purpose: Relationship between two quantitative measures as plotted points, single-series or by segment — the FIRST net-new type of the chart-expansion programme, built as the prove-one-then-wave exemplar (2026-07-22). Semantic SVG styled by tokens, animated by CSS, described by a real table. PROVISIONAL-AGENT: awaiting Dave's eyeball of the lock-up (chart + controls toolbar + legend + table spine, projected across 4 themes × light/dark) before the other 8 types fan out.

props.name: series
props.$note: 1–3 segments; each carries colour (data/series/N) + MARKER SHAPE (circle · square · diamond) + letter key A/B/C repeated in the legend (§04.3) — colour is never the only channel (dv-011). Points carry class dv-series so the gate reads the fills directly (dv-016).

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> in the figure (dv-005), surfaced by native <details>.

props.name: trendLine
props.$note: Not baked in the exemplar — a straight reference/regression line is a Layer-2 option raised for Dave (would be a dv-series <line>, dv-line-011-clean by construction).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: single series
variants.use: One relationship (income × savings); circle markers, both-axis gridlines + numeric ticks.

variants.name: segments
variants.use: 2–3 groups; shapes + letters + legend names carry identity alongside colour (Everyday · Saver · Investor).

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — axis ticks + legend + table .t-cm-legal · axis titles .t-cm-caption
tokens.series: data/series/1–3 bound here (mode-stable candidate C); measured 3.31–5.26:1 both modes vs the page (dv-016 ≥3:1 BLOCKING clean — identical palette to Chart-line/bar)
tokens.markers: fill = the series token, stroke = background/default (page) at 1.5 for overlap legibility — the halation-aware choice on dark (R-D6 bloom/dance axis)
tokens.axis: text/default at 0.6 alpha; baseline = border/action-strong on BOTH axes (two quantitative axes); gridlines = text/default at per-mode alpha .10/.16 (kit greys have no post-R-D16 home — receipted; quiet-ink token gap data/axis+data/grid stays open, D-side)
tokens.$survey: Net-new for the chart-expansion programme; grounds its vocabulary in the promoted kit (Chart-line/bar) — same frame, palette, marker shapes, table spine. A single-series scatter section also seeds _proforma/DataViz-interactive.html (DV-D01, one file).

motion.entry: Points fade in on a gentle stagger (no line to draw against) — CSS-only (DEF-003), animation-delay per marker; single series ~90ms apart, segments stagger 0–360ms per group.
motion.hover: <title> carries each point's income + savings values natively.
motion.reducedMotion: Fade sits inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale — text must not scale. Static answer: fixed 580×260 + horizontal scroll. A runtime fit() would be JS Layer-2, not baked.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using these series colours for DIFFERENT data in the same journey (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img" with a data-summary aria-label describing the relationship.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; each point <title> carries its two values (and segment for multi-series); the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Only the <details> summary is focusable; the figure is passive.
accessibility.nonText: Point fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016); segment identity = shape + letter + name, never colour alone (§04.3 / 1.4.1).

antiPatterns: Colour as the only segment identity (shapes + letters + names, always)
Connecting the points with a line (that is a line chart — scatter shows the cloud; a straight trend line is an explicit opt-in only)
White-fill markers hardcoded on dark (halation; the default is series fill + page stroke)
Scaling the SVG proportionally at narrow widths (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)

tokenValidation.result: PASS — series 1–3 ≥3.31:1 both modes; ink/baseline 14.6:1; DataViz gate 0 blocking / 0 advisory on both figures.
tokenValidation.$note: NET-NEW exemplar, chart-expansion programme (prove-one-then-wave). PROVISIONAL-AGENT pending Dave's lock-up eyeball; the other 8 types fan out as worker lanes after.
